resources.promptText:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ONE standalone wide raster illustrated story-map underlay for «Альбом дружбы», 1400×680 px or near 2.06:1. This is the MAP ART ONLY, not a webpage.
Input image 1 is the GEOGRAPHIC LAYOUT reference. Preserve its land silhouette, aspect ratio, coastline arrangement, far-east peninsulas and islands, positions of the blank surrounding seas, and overall placement within the canvas. Land occupies the same positions and scale as input 1. Do not reinterpret the projection or reshape the land. Input image 2 is the STYLE reference: use the charming little hand-painted trees, miniature mountains and pale pistachio watercolor land from its map, never its webpage, characters or book frame.
Paint the interior of the input-1 land silhouette in a delicate pale pistachio and sage watercolor wash, fine warm-pencil edge, small subtle patches of green terrain. Scatter MANY SEPARATELY DRAWN SMALL TREE VIGNETTES over the land: individual firs, modest clusters of firs and birches, airy woodland motifs with ample space between them. Several miniature mountain chains with tiny gray-brown peaks and light ivory snow, distributed as story-map details. A few very thin winding pale-blue decorative rivers viewed from above, not one big scenic river.
Include five tiny gentle naturalistic watercolor animal vignettes in separate open areas WELL INSIDE the land, not at the edges: one small brown bear, one deer, one red fox, one white polar bear, one small striped tiger. Each is roughly the height of two or three of the small trees, secondary to the map; no oversized mascots. They are symbolic nature illustrations, not scientific claims about exact species ranges. Similarly the rivers and mountains are decorative, not hydrological or relief data.
View: strictly a FLAT ILLUSTRATED MAP seen from overhead; tree/mountain/animal symbols may have the charming pictorial elevations of a traditional children's story atlas. NO horizon anywhere, NO sky, NO continuous landscape scene, NO panoramic perspective, NO single photo-like forest or river-valley vista. The entire canvas stays a broad map with evenly distributed little landscape motifs. Keep it light, warm, airy and delicately textured like input 2.
Background: TRUE TRANSPARENT surrounding ocean and outside the land silhouette, including blank sea inlets. Preserve genuine alpha outside the land; no solid black/white surround, no checkerboard drawn into the artwork. If the tool cannot preserve transparency, use uniform cream #FAF4E8 only. No ocean waves or sea illustrations.
Absolutely NO words, letters, labels, dotted routes, markers, pins, stars, circles, internal political borders, UI, buttons, website layout, book/frame, compass, legend, flags, portraits, lesson characters, buildings, watermarks. Do not copy any of those from input 2. Output one complete map underlay raster only.
